title: Calculate your net worth
summary: Assets minus liabilities. Updated quarterly, this is the only number that measures real progress.
detailsHtml:
Why it matters

Income measures flow; net worth measures stock. You can earn a high income and have a negative net worth (high earners with consumer debt and no savings). You can earn modestly and accumulate substantial wealth (the millionaire-next-door pattern). Net worth is the lagging indicator that captures whether all the other decisions are working.

What to include

Assets: cash and equivalents, taxable brokerage balances, retirement account balances, home equity (current market value minus mortgage balance), other real estate, business interests, vehicles at realistic resale value. Liabilities: all mortgages, student loans, auto loans, credit card balances, any private debt. The remainder is your net worth. Update quarterly; the trend line matters more than the absolute number.
